subject: Tooling renewal risk register & mitigation
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Tooling renewal risk register & mitigation

Team — attaching an initial inventory (renewal_inventory_2026.xlsx) I've collated from procurement and finance. High level notes: GitHub Enterprise renewal window spans Jan 10–20, JetBrains seats renew Feb 03, and Atlassian (Jira/Confluence) is on a rolling contract that we can lock in by Dec if we move quickly.

I ran a quick risk pass and flagged the following immediate concerns:
- Overlapping renewals (Jan–Feb) that could push a large one-off spend into Q1.
- JetBrains has a seat-based true-up clause that will increase cost if we miss decomm dates.
- Atlassian consolidation discount requires a decision by Dec 15 to hit FY pricing.

Ask: can each of you own one vendor track and add three mitigation actions to the sheet by next Tue (11/10)? I propose a short sync on 11/12 to align procurement requests and a contingency credit request path.

Attachments: renewal_inventory_2026.xlsx

Thanks,
Steph
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Tooling renewal risk register & mitigation

Steph — thanks for pulling this together. I took the GitHub tab and added: current committed seats, trial/temporary seats we can sunburst, and an early-renewal discount threshold note. Quick clarifications:
1) GitHub: we have a 30-day notice SLA to lock pricing; prefer to start procurement 45 days before Jan 10.
2) JetBrains: Marissa, can you confirm how many floating licenses are attached to legacy CI agents (they can be reclaimed).
3) Atlassian: Laura, can you surface any existing marketplace apps that prevent consolidation?

I'll propose owners on the sheet and have my procurement contact draft a consolidation ask if we decide to move Atlassian into a single contract.

On the meeting: 11/12 at 11am PT works for me.

-Karthik
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@atlassian.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 08:42:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Tooling renewal risk register & mitigation

Hi Stephanie and team — thanks for the heads up and for sharing the inventory. I attached a consolidation quote (atlassian_consolidation_quote_v3.pdf) with three options: standard renewal, 12-month consolidation discount, and a 24-month committed discount that requires political sign-off. Key points from our side:
- We can commit to the consolidation discount if a single contract is signed by Dec 15.
- Marketplace apps: a small number (2) will need L2 reviews; we can include a temp waiver to keep integrations running during migration.
- We can provide a short-term credit if a contractual lag forces a gap in coverage during cutover.

Elena
Elena Rossi
Enterprise Sales — Strategic Accounts
Atlassian

- Karthik will submit GitHub early-renewal request (procurement ticket #PR-2234) by 11/24 to secure pricing.
- Marissa (me) will run the JetBrains seat audit, reclaim 42 floating licenses tied to deprecated CI boxes, and propose a true-up threshold cap.
